tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Details of Vehicle Registration Certificate, Insurance Certificate, Driver Details and Valid Driving Licenses, Fitness Certificate, Agreement copies
Tenderer in its name should have in the last 5 financial years 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 achieved in at least two financial year minimum annual financial turnover of not less than Rs. 6.00 Lakhs

The Bidder Should have supplied same or similar type of vehicles to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company as indicated above in the bid document before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant work experience to be submitted. In past five financial years

The bidder should not have been debarred or blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Central and State Govt. undertakings enterprises or Organizations and by any other Government bodies or Organizations, or any major Enterprise or Organization in India for non satisfactory performance, corrupt and Fraudulent or any other unethical business practices, not meeting critical conditions or security clearance during the past. Bidder to submit the declaration on Stamp Paper
